  "content": "# AURA: Цифровой рудник «Актогай» на платформе OpenEgiz

> Цифровой двойник открытого медного карьера «Актогай» (KAZ Minerals) для открытого конкурса «Цифровой рудник на OpenEgiz».
> Команда: **AURA** (Участник: `@AURA-afk-lang`).

## Быстрый запуск на Стенде

Решение развертывается и запускается в изолированном судейском окружении Ubuntu 24.04 последовательным выполнением команд:

```bash
# 1. Установка утилит make и curl (если отсутствуют в базовом образе)
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y make curl

# 2. Поднятие платформы OpenEgiz (Eclipse Ditto, InfluxDB, Grafana, Mosquitto)
make up

# 3. Запуск цифрового двойника Актогай (создание вещей в Ditto, симулятор, 3D-сцена)
make aktogay-start
```

После запуска:
- **Интерактивная 3D-визуализация карьера с пультом What-If:** `http://localhost:5000`
- **Дашборды управления и аналитики в Grafana:** `http://localhost:3000` (логин и сгенерированный пароль печатаются при выполнении `make up`; путь: *Dashboards → OpenEgiz Examples → Цифровой рудник «Актогай» (Team AURA)*).
- **REST API сценариев «Что-Если»:** `http://localhost:5000/api/whatif/{ex1-fail|road-block|dilution|reset}`
- **Текущее состояние и телеметрия в JSON:** `http://localhost:5000/api/state`

{

  "content": ".PHONY: up down ps logs smoke clean aktogay aktogay-stop example-mine example-mine-stop install uninstall status endpoints upgrade upload-build generate-data copy-build unity-demo check-secrets check-public-host

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Docker Compose deployment (laptops, CI, contest judges): deploy/compose/
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
COMPOSE_BASE := docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml
# Once `make example-mine` has run, every compose command also loads the mine
# overlay, so `down` stops its simulator and `up` keeps its Grafana dashboard.
# `make clean` forgets it.
MINE_MARKER  := deploy/compose/.example-mine
MINE_COMPOSE := examples/mine/compose.yml
AKTOGAY_MARKER  := deploy/compose/.aktogay
AKTOGAY_COMPOSE := team/compose.yml
COMPOSE := $(COMPOSE_BASE)$(if $(wildcard $(MINE_MARKER)), -f $(MINE_COMPOSE))$(if $(wildcard $(AKTOGAY_MARKER)), -f $(AKTOGAY_COMPOSE))

## Start the whole platform with Docker Compose (first run: generates credentials)
up:
	@bash scripts/compose-env.sh
	@bash scripts/compose-preflight.sh
	$(COMPOSE) up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 900
	@# `--wait` does not wait for one-shot jobs to finish: a running init counts
	@# as up. Wait for it to exit, then check how.
	@test "$$(docker wait $$($(COMPOSE) ps -a -q init))" = 0 || { \
	  echo "ERROR: the init job (policy + Ditto connections) failed:"; $(COMPOSE) logs init; exit 1; }
	@bash scripts/compose-wait-ready.sh
	@bash scripts/compose-urls.sh

## Stop the platform, keep data
down:
	$(COMPOSE) down

## Show compose service status
ps:
	@$(COMPOSE) ps -a

## Follow logs (one service: make logs S=gateway)
logs:
	$(COMPOSE) logs -f --tail=100 $(S)

## End-to-end check of the running compose stack
smoke:
	@bash scripts/compose-smoke.sh

aktogay-start: aktogay

## Run Team AURA's Aktogay Digital Mine (twins + physics sim + 3D Three.js + What-If REST + Grafana)
aktogay: up
	$(COMPOSE_BASE) -f $(AKTOGAY_COMPOSE) up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 300
	@touch $(AKTOGAY_MARKER)
	@echo ""
	@echo "================================================================================"
	@echo "  Aktogay Digital Mine (Team AURA) is UP and RUNNING!"
	@echo "  - 3D WebGL Spatial Twin:  http://localhost:5000"
	@echo "  - What-If Dispatch API:   http://localhost:5000/api/whatif/{scenario}"
	@echo "  - Grafana Dashboard:      http://localhost:3000 (OpenEgiz Examples -> Aktogay)"
	@echo "================================================================================"

## Stop the Aktogay simulator (twins and data stay)
aktogay-stop:
	$(COMPOSE_BASE) -f $(AKTOGAY_COMPOSE) stop aktogay-simulator

## Run the Example Mine (twins + haul-cycle simulator + Grafana dashboard) on the compose stack
example-mine: up
	$(COMPOSE_BASE) -f $(MINE_COMPOSE) up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 300
	@touch $(MINE_MARKER)
	@echo "Example Mine running: Grafana -> Dashboards -> OpenEgiz Examples -> Example Mine"

## Stop the Example Mine simulator (twins and data stay)
example-mine-stop:
	$(COMPOSE_BASE) -f $(MINE_COMPOSE) stop mine-simulator

## Stop the platform and DELETE all its data and credentials
clean:
	$(COMPOSE) down -v --remove-orphans
	rm -f deploy/compose/.env $(MINE_MARKER) $(AKTOGAY_MARKER)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helm deployment (servers): the chart at the repository root
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Several values reference names derived from the release name (e.g. the
# telegraf configmap), so the release MUST be called "opentwins" until those
# references are made release-agnostic.
RELEASE_NAME := opentwins
NAMESPACE    := opentwins
CHART_PATH   := .

# Credentials live OUTSIDE this repo (rotated 2026-08-07). values.yaml carries
# only invalid placeholders, so install/upgrade must always be given this
# override file. Deliberately a hard failure rather than a silent fallback:
# deploying the placeholders would break Ditto auth and telemetry ingest.
SECRETS_FILE ?= $(HOME)/openegiz-deploy/secrets.values.yaml

# Address browsers use to reach this host; the Grafana app plugin calls Ditto
# and the extended API from the browser. Defaults to the first node's
# InternalIP; override with `make install PUBLIC_HOST=my-host.example`.
PUBLIC_HOST ?= $(shell kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.addresses[?(@.type=="InternalIP")].address}' 2>/dev/null)

check-public-host:
	@test -n "$(PUBLIC_HOST)" || { \
	  echo "ERROR: could not determine PUBLIC_HOST from kubectl."; \
	  echo "       Pass it explicitly: make install PUBLIC_HOST=<ip-or-hostname>"; \
	  exit 1; }

check-secrets:
	@test -f "$(SECRETS_FILE)" || { \
	  echo "ERROR: secrets override not found: $(SECRETS_FILE)"; \
	  echo "       It holds the Ditto/Grafana/InfluxDB credentials that are"; \
	  echo "       intentionally absent from values.yaml. Create it from"; \
	  echo "       secrets.values.yaml.example, or point to another file with:"; \
	  echo "       make install SECRETS_FILE=/path/to/file"; \
	  exit 1; }

## Install the OpenEgiz Helm chart
install: check-secrets check-public-host
	helm install $(RELEASE_NAME) $(CHART_PATH) -n $(NAMESPACE) --create-namespace -f "$(SECRETS_FILE)" --set grafanaPlugin.publicHost=$(PUBLIC_HOST) --wait --timeout=15m --debug

## Upgrade the OpenEgiz Helm chart
upgrade: check-secrets check-public-host
	helm upgrade $(RELEASE_NAME) $(CHART_PATH) -n $(NAMESPACE) -f "$(SECRETS_FILE)" --set grafanaPlugin.publicHost=$(PUBLIC_HOST) --wait --timeout=15m --debug

## Uninstall the OpenEgiz Helm chart
uninstall:
	helm uninstall $(RELEASE_NAME) -n $(NAMESPACE) --wait

## Show pod statuses
status:
	@kubectl get pods -n $(NAMESPACE) -o wide

## Show all service endpoints (IP + port)
endpoints:
	@bash scripts/show-endpoints.sh

## Upload Unity WebGL build files to the nginx pod
upload-build:
	@bash scripts/upload-build.sh $(RELEASE_NAME)

## Oven demo: create the oven twins, then stream telemetry (Ctrl+C to stop).
## Compose by default; Helm: make generate-data MQTT_PORT=30511 DITTO_URL=http://localhost:30525 DITTO_PASSWORD=...
generate-data:
	@bash scripts/demo-oven.sh

## Download the demo Unity WebGL scene (88 MB, kept out of git) into ./build/
unity-demo:
	@bash scripts/unity-demo.sh

## Copy 4 Unity WebGL build files from SRC into ./build/
## Usage: make copy-build SRC=/path/to/source
copy-build:
	@bash scripts/copy-build.sh $(SRC)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Static checks, same as the CI lint job: run before pushing
.PHONY: lint
lint:
	helm lint . -f secrets.values.yaml.example --set grafanaPlugin.publicHost=127.0.0.1
	helm template opentwins . -n opentwins -f secrets.values.yaml.example \
	  --set grafanaPlugin.publicHost=127.0.0.1 > /dev/null
	git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n
	git ls-files -z 'scripts/*.sh' 'deploy/*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck --severity=warning
	git ls-files -z '*.py' | xargs -0 python3 -c 'import ast, sys; [ast.parse(open(f, encoding="utf-8").read(), f) for f in sys.argv[1:]]'
	@bash scripts/compose-env.sh
	docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml config -q
	@echo "lint: ok"
",

}

MINE_COMPOSE := examples/mine/compose.yml
AKTOGAY_MARKER  := deploy/compose/.aktogay
AKTOGAY_COMPOSE := team/compose.yml

class AktogayPit:
    def __init__(self, seed: int = 42):
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.sim_time_s = 0.0
        self.target_grade = 0.48

        # Excavators
        self.excavators = {
            "excavator-01": Excavator("excavator-01", 0.64, "high_grade"),
            "excavator-02": Excavator("excavator-02", 0.40, "rom_grade"),
            "excavator-03": Excavator("excavator-03", 0.08, "waste"),
        }

        # Trucks: 2 on EX-01, 2 on EX-02, 1 on EX-03
        self.trucks = [
            Truck("truck-01", "excavator-01", initial_progress=10.0),
            Truck("truck-02", "excavator-01", initial_progress=60.0),
            Truck("truck-03", "excavator-02", initial_progress=25.0),
            Truck("truck-04", "excavator-02", initial_progress=75.0),
            Truck("truck-05", "excavator-03", initial_progress=40.0),
        ]

        # Crusher & Stockpiles
        self.crusher_state = "crushing"
        self.crusher_throughput_tph = 0.0
        self.crusher_hopper_level = 45.0
        self.crusher_tonnes_total = 0.0
        self.crusher_grade_weighted_sum = 0.0
        self.crusher_current_feed_grade = 0.48
        self.recent_dumps = []  # (time, tonnes, grade)

        self.stockpile_tonnes = 45200.0
        self.stockpile_grade = 0.51
        self.waste_dump_tonnes = 0.0
        self.fuel_consumed_total_l = 0.0

        # Safety radar
        self.radar_status = "normal"
        self.displacement_rate_mm = 0.2
        self.road_status = "open"

        # What-If Flags
        self.whatif_ex1_failure = False
        self.whatif_road_blocked = False
        self.whatif_dilution = False

    def trigger_ex1_failure(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_ex1_failure
        if active == self.whatif_ex1_failure:
            return self.whatif_ex1_failure
        self.whatif_ex1_failure = active
        if active:
            self.excavators["excavator-01"].state = "breakdown"
            # Reroute any trucks heading to EX-01
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.shovel_target == "excavator-01" and truck.state in ("returning", "queued_at_excavator"):
                    truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
                    truck.current_segment = "diverted_to_ex2"
        else:
            self.excavators["excavator-01"].state = "idle"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.current_segment == "diverted_to_ex2":
                    truck.current_segment = "ramp_down"
        return self.whatif_ex1_failure

    def trigger_road_block(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_road_blocked
        if active == self.whatif_road_blocked:
            return self.whatif_road_blocked
        self.whatif_road_blocked = active
        if active:
            self.radar_status = "alert_collapse"
            self.displacement_rate_mm = 14.8
            self.road_status = "closed_collapse"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.state in ("hauling", "returning"):
                    truck.total_route_km += DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA
                    truck.current_segment = "detour_bypass"
        else:
            self.radar_status = "normal"
            self.displacement_rate_mm = 0.2
            self.road_status = "open"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.shovel_target == "excavator-01":
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX1_TO_CRUSHER
                elif truck.shovel_target == "excavator-02":
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER
                else:
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX3_TO_WASTE
                if truck.current_segment == "detour_bypass":
                    truck.current_segment = "ramp_main" if truck.state == "hauling" else "ramp_down"
        return self.whatif_road_blocked

    def trigger_dilution(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_dilution
        if active == self.whatif_dilution:
            return self.whatif_dilution
        self.whatif_dilution = active
        if active:
            self.excavators["excavator-02"].face_grade = 0.22  # Sudden dilution
        else:
            self.excavators["excavator-02"].face_grade = self.excavators["excavator-02"].base_grade
        return self.whatif_dilution

    def reset_whatif(self):
        self.trigger_ex1_failure(False)
        self.trigger_road_block(False)
        self.trigger_dilution(False)

    def dispatch_decision(self, truck: Truck):
        """Dynamic dispatch & ore blending algorithm (Шихтовка)."""
        if truck.name == "truck-05":
            # Dedicated waste truck
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-03"
            truck.destination = "waste-dump-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX3_TO_WASTE + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
            return

        if self.whatif_ex1_failure:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
            return

        # Target grade is 0.48% Cu. EX-01 is 0.64%, EX-02 is 0.40% (or 0.22% if diluted).
        # Check current moving average grade at crusher
        current_grade = self.crusher_current_feed_grade
        ex1_queue = len(self.excavators["excavator-01"].queue)
        ex2_queue = len(self.excavators["excavator-02"].queue)

        if current_grade < self.target_grade and ex1_queue <= ex2_queue + 1:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-01"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX1_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
        else:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        self.sim_time_s += dt

        # Simulate natural stochastic grade noise in faces
        for ex in self.excavators.values():
            if ex.name != "excavator-03" and not self.whatif_dilution:
                noise = self.rng.gauss(0, 0.001 * math.sqrt(dt))
                ex.face_grade = max(0.1, min(1.2, ex.face_grade + noise))

        # Update trucks
        for truck in self.trucks:
            self._step_truck(truck, dt)

        # Update crusher metrics (sliding 1-hour window for throughput)
        self.recent_dumps = [(t, w, g) for t, w, g in self.recent_dumps if self.sim_time_s - t <= 3600.0]
        window_tonnes = sum(w for _, w, _ in self.recent_dumps)
        window_seconds = min(self.sim_time_s, 3600.0) or 1.0
        self.crusher_throughput_tph = (window_tonnes * 3600.0) / window_seconds

        if self.recent_dumps:
            total_g = sum(w * g for _, w, g in self.recent_dumps)
            self.crusher_current_feed_grade = total_g / window_tonnes
        else:
            self.crusher_current_feed_grade = 0.48

    def _step_truck(self, truck: Truck, dt: float):
        ex = self.excavators.get(truck.shovel_target)

        if truck.state == "queued_at_excavator":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_IDLE
            if ex.state == "breakdown":
                # Emergency reroute
                self.dispatch_decision(truck)
                truck.state = "returning"
                return

            if truck not in ex.queue:
                ex.queue.append(truck)

            # If shovel is idle and this truck is first in line
            if ex.state == "idle" and ex.queue and ex.queue[0] == truck:
                ex.state = "loading"
                truck.state = "loading"
                truck.timer = 0.0
                truck.payload_t = 0.0

        elif truck.state == "loading":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = 20.0
            truck.timer += dt
            ex.state = "loading"

            # Fill bucket passes
            while truck.timer >= PASS_SECONDS and truck.payload_t < TRUCK_CAPACITY_T:
                truck.timer -= PASS_SECONDS
                truck.payload_t = min(TRUCK_CAPACITY_T, truck.payload_t + BUCKET_TONNES)
                ex.passes_total += 1
                ex.tonnes_loaded += BUCKET_TONNES

            if truck.payload_t >= TRUCK_CAPACITY_T:
                if ex.queue and ex.queue[0] == truck:
                    ex.queue.pop(0)
                ex.state = "idle"
                truck.state = "hauling"
                truck.grade_in_box = ex.face_grade
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0
                truck.current_segment = "ramp_main" if not self.whatif_road_blocked else "detour_bypass"

        elif truck.state == "hauling":
            # Loaded climbing up pit ramps
            truck.speed_kmh = SPEED_UPHILL_LOADED_KMH
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_UPHILL_LOADED
            dist_step = (truck.speed_kmh / 3600.0) * dt
            truck.route_position_km += dist_step
            truck.progress_pct = min(100.0, (truck.route_position_km / truck.total_route_km) * 100.0)

            # Heat up tyres on heavy haul
            truck.tire_tkph = min(320.0, truck.tire_tkph + 0.1 * dt)

            if truck.route_position_km >= truck.total_route_km:
                truck.state = "dumping"
                truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
                truck.timer = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 100.0

        elif truck.state == "dumping":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_IDLE
            truck.timer += dt

            if truck.timer >= DUMP_SECONDS:
                # Record dump
                if truck.destination == "crusher-01":
                    self.crusher_tonnes_total += truck.payload_t
                    self.crusher_grade_weighted_sum += truck.payload_t * truck.grade_in_box
                    self.recent_dumps.append((self.sim_time_s, truck.payload_t, truck.grade_in_box))
                else:
                    self.waste_dump_tonnes += truck.payload_t

                truck.trips_total += 1
                truck.payload_t = 0.0
                truck.grade_in_box = 0.0
                truck.state = "returning"
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0

                # Make next dispatch decision
                self.dispatch_decision(truck)
                truck.current_segment = "ramp_down"

        elif truck.state == "returning":
            # Empty descending into pit
            truck.speed_kmh = SPEED_DOWNHILL_EMPTY_KMH
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_DOWNHILL_EMPTY
            dist_step = (truck.speed_kmh / 3600.0) * dt
            truck.route_position_km += dist_step
            truck.progress_pct = min(100.0, (truck.route_position_km / truck.total_route_km) * 100.0)

            # Cool down tyres
            truck.tire_tkph = max(200.0, truck.tire_tkph - 0.08 * dt)

            if truck.route_position_km >= truck.total_route_km:
                truck.state = "queued_at_excavator"
                truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0

        # Burn fuel
        fuel_burned = (truck.fuel_rate_lph / 3600.0) * dt
        truck.fuel_tank_l = max(50.0, truck.fuel_tank_l - fuel_burned)
        self.fuel_consumed_total_l += fuel_burned

    def snapshot(self):
        """Assemble full state dictionary for Eclipse Ditto and 3D UI."""
        avg_grade = (self.crusher_grade_weighted_sum / self.crusher_tonnes_total) if self.crusher_tonnes_total > 0 else 0.48
        energy_intensity = (self.fuel_consumed_total_l / self.crusher_tonnes_total) if self.crusher_tonnes_total > 0 else 0.0

        state_dict = {
            "mine-01": {
                "tonnes_mined": {"value": round(self.crusher_tonnes_total, 1), "unit": "t"},
                "avg_grade": {"value": round(avg_grade, 3), "unit": "% Cu"},
                "trucks_active": {"value": len(self.trucks), "unit": "trucks"},
                "fuel_consumed_total": {"value": round(self.fuel_consumed_total_l, 1), "unit": "l"},
                "energy_intensity": {"value": round(energy_intensity, 2), "unit": "l/t"},
                "fuel_rate": {"value": round(sum(t.fuel_rate_lph for t in self.trucks), 1), "unit": "l/h"},
                "current_feed_grade": {"value": round(self.crusher_current_feed_grade, 3), "unit": "% Cu"},
            },
            "crusher-01": {
                "state": {"value": self.crusher_state},
                "throughput": {"value": round(self.crusher_throughput_tph, 1), "unit": "t/h"},
                "feed_grade": {"value": round(self.crusher_current_feed_grade, 3), "unit": "% Cu"},
                "hopper_level": {"value": round(self.crusher_hopper_level, 1), "unit": "%"},
                "tonnes_total": {"value": round(self.crusher_tonnes_total, 1), "unit": "t"},
                "power_draw_kw": {"value": round(450.0 + self.crusher_throughput_tph * 0.15, 1), "unit": "kW"},
            },
            "stockpile-01": {
                "tonnes_stored": {"value": round(self.stockpile_tonnes, 1), "unit": "t"},
                "avg_grade": {"value": round(self.stockpile_grade, 3), "unit": "% Cu"},
            },
            "waste-dump-01": {
                "tonnes_dumped": {"value": round(self.waste_dump_tonnes, 1), "unit": "t"},
            },
            "slope-radar-01": {
                "status": {"value": self.radar_status},
                "displacement_rate_mm_day": {"value": round(self.displacement_rate_mm, 2), "unit": "mm/day"},
                "road_status": {"value": self.road_status},
            },
        }

        for ex in self.excavators.values():
            state_dict[ex.name] = ex.features()

        for truck in self.trucks:
            state_dict[truck.name] = truck.features()

        return state_dict


def ditto_modify_features(name: str, features: dict) -> dict:

class AktogayPit:
    def __init__(self, seed: int = 42):
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.sim_time_s = 0.0
        self.target_grade = 0.48

        # Excavators
        self.excavators = {
            "excavator-01": Excavator("excavator-01", 0.64, "high_grade"),
            "excavator-02": Excavator("excavator-02", 0.40, "rom_grade"),
            "excavator-03": Excavator("excavator-03", 0.08, "waste"),
        }

        # Trucks: 2 on EX-01, 2 on EX-02, 1 on EX-03
        self.trucks = [
            Truck("truck-01", "excavator-01", initial_progress=10.0),
            Truck("truck-02", "excavator-01", initial_progress=60.0),
            Truck("truck-03", "excavator-02", initial_progress=25.0),
            Truck("truck-04", "excavator-02", initial_progress=75.0),
            Truck("truck-05", "excavator-03", initial_progress=40.0),
        ]

        # Crusher & Stockpiles
        self.crusher_state = "crushing"
        self.crusher_throughput_tph = 0.0
        self.crusher_hopper_level = 45.0
        self.crusher_tonnes_total = 0.0
        self.crusher_grade_weighted_sum = 0.0
        self.crusher_current_feed_grade = 0.48
        self.recent_dumps = []  # (time, tonnes, grade)

        self.stockpile_tonnes = 45200.0
        self.stockpile_grade = 0.51
        self.waste_dump_tonnes = 0.0
        self.fuel_consumed_total_l = 0.0

        # Safety radar
        self.radar_status = "normal"
        self.displacement_rate_mm = 0.2
        self.road_status = "open"

        # What-If Flags
        self.whatif_ex1_failure = False
        self.whatif_road_blocked = False
        self.whatif_dilution = False

    def trigger_ex1_failure(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_ex1_failure
        if active == self.whatif_ex1_failure:
            return self.whatif_ex1_failure
        self.whatif_ex1_failure = active
        if active:
            self.excavators["excavator-01"].state = "breakdown"
            # Reroute any trucks heading to EX-01
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.shovel_target == "excavator-01" and truck.state in ("returning", "queued_at_excavator"):
                    truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
                    truck.current_segment = "diverted_to_ex2"
        else:
            self.excavators["excavator-01"].state = "idle"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.current_segment == "diverted_to_ex2":
                    truck.current_segment = "ramp_down"
        return self.whatif_ex1_failure

    def trigger_road_block(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_road_blocked
        if active == self.whatif_road_blocked:
            return self.whatif_road_blocked
        self.whatif_road_blocked = active
        if active:
            self.radar_status = "alert_collapse"
            self.displacement_rate_mm = 14.8
            self.road_status = "closed_collapse"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.state in ("hauling", "returning"):
                    truck.total_route_km += DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA
                    truck.current_segment = "detour_bypass"
        else:
            self.radar_status = "normal"
            self.displacement_rate_mm = 0.2
            self.road_status = "open"
            for truck in self.trucks:
                if truck.shovel_target == "excavator-01":
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX1_TO_CRUSHER
                elif truck.shovel_target == "excavator-02":
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER
                else:
                    truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX3_TO_WASTE
                if truck.current_segment == "detour_bypass":
                    truck.current_segment = "ramp_main" if truck.state == "hauling" else "ramp_down"
        return self.whatif_road_blocked

    def trigger_dilution(self, active: bool = None) -> bool:
        if active is None:
            active = not self.whatif_dilution
        if active == self.whatif_dilution:
            return self.whatif_dilution
        self.whatif_dilution = active
        if active:
            self.excavators["excavator-02"].face_grade = 0.22  # Sudden dilution
        else:
            self.excavators["excavator-02"].face_grade = self.excavators["excavator-02"].base_grade
        return self.whatif_dilution

    def reset_whatif(self):
        self.trigger_ex1_failure(False)
        self.trigger_road_block(False)
        self.trigger_dilution(False)

    def dispatch_decision(self, truck: Truck):
        """Dynamic dispatch & ore blending algorithm (Шихтовка)."""
        if truck.name == "truck-05":
            # Dedicated waste truck
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-03"
            truck.destination = "waste-dump-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX3_TO_WASTE + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
            return

        if self.whatif_ex1_failure:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
            return

        # Target grade is 0.48% Cu. EX-01 is 0.64%, EX-02 is 0.40% (or 0.22% if diluted).
        # Check current moving average grade at crusher
        current_grade = self.crusher_current_feed_grade
        ex1_queue = len(self.excavators["excavator-01"].queue)
        ex2_queue = len(self.excavators["excavator-02"].queue)

        if current_grade < self.target_grade and ex1_queue <= ex2_queue + 1:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-01"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX1_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)
        else:
            truck.shovel_target = "excavator-02"
            truck.destination = "crusher-01"
            truck.total_route_km = DIST_EX2_TO_CRUSHER + (DIST_DETOUR_EXTRA if self.whatif_road_blocked else 0.0)

    def step(self, dt: float):
        self.sim_time_s += dt

        # Simulate natural stochastic grade noise in faces
        for ex in self.excavators.values():
            if ex.name != "excavator-03" and not self.whatif_dilution:
                noise = self.rng.gauss(0, 0.001 * math.sqrt(dt))
                ex.face_grade = max(0.1, min(1.2, ex.face_grade + noise))

        # Update trucks
        for truck in self.trucks:
            self._step_truck(truck, dt)

        # Update crusher metrics (sliding 1-hour window for throughput)
        self.recent_dumps = [(t, w, g) for t, w, g in self.recent_dumps if self.sim_time_s - t <= 3600.0]
        window_tonnes = sum(w for _, w, _ in self.recent_dumps)
        window_seconds = min(self.sim_time_s, 3600.0) or 1.0
        self.crusher_throughput_tph = (window_tonnes * 3600.0) / window_seconds

        if self.recent_dumps:
            total_g = sum(w * g for _, w, g in self.recent_dumps)
            self.crusher_current_feed_grade = total_g / window_tonnes
        else:
            self.crusher_current_feed_grade = 0.48

    def _step_truck(self, truck: Truck, dt: float):
        ex = self.excavators.get(truck.shovel_target)

        if truck.state == "queued_at_excavator":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_IDLE
            if ex.state == "breakdown":
                # Emergency reroute
                self.dispatch_decision(truck)
                truck.state = "returning"
                return

            if truck not in ex.queue:
                ex.queue.append(truck)

            # If shovel is idle and this truck is first in line
            if ex.state == "idle" and ex.queue and ex.queue[0] == truck:
                ex.state = "loading"
                truck.state = "loading"
                truck.timer = 0.0
                truck.payload_t = 0.0

        elif truck.state == "loading":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = 20.0
            truck.timer += dt
            ex.state = "loading"

            # Fill bucket passes
            while truck.timer >= PASS_SECONDS and truck.payload_t < TRUCK_CAPACITY_T:
                truck.timer -= PASS_SECONDS
                truck.payload_t = min(TRUCK_CAPACITY_T, truck.payload_t + BUCKET_TONNES)
                ex.passes_total += 1
                ex.tonnes_loaded += BUCKET_TONNES

            if truck.payload_t >= TRUCK_CAPACITY_T:
                if ex.queue and ex.queue[0] == truck:
                    ex.queue.pop(0)
                ex.state = "idle"
                truck.state = "hauling"
                truck.grade_in_box = ex.face_grade
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0
                truck.current_segment = "ramp_main" if not self.whatif_road_blocked else "detour_bypass"

        elif truck.state == "hauling":
            # Loaded climbing up pit ramps
            truck.speed_kmh = SPEED_UPHILL_LOADED_KMH
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_UPHILL_LOADED
            dist_step = (truck.speed_kmh / 3600.0) * dt
            truck.route_position_km += dist_step
            truck.progress_pct = min(100.0, (truck.route_position_km / truck.total_route_km) * 100.0)

            # Heat up tyres on heavy haul
            truck.tire_tkph = min(320.0, truck.tire_tkph + 0.1 * dt)

            if truck.route_position_km >= truck.total_route_km:
                truck.state = "dumping"
                truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
                truck.timer = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 100.0

        elif truck.state == "dumping":
            truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_IDLE
            truck.timer += dt

            if truck.timer >= DUMP_SECONDS:
                # Record dump
                if truck.destination == "crusher-01":
                    self.crusher_tonnes_total += truck.payload_t
                    self.crusher_grade_weighted_sum += truck.payload_t * truck.grade_in_box
                    self.recent_dumps.append((self.sim_time_s, truck.payload_t, truck.grade_in_box))
                else:
                    self.waste_dump_tonnes += truck.payload_t

                truck.trips_total += 1
                truck.payload_t = 0.0
                truck.grade_in_box = 0.0
                truck.state = "returning"
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0

                # Make next dispatch decision
                self.dispatch_decision(truck)
                truck.current_segment = "ramp_down"

        elif truck.state == "returning":
            # Empty descending into pit
            truck.speed_kmh = SPEED_DOWNHILL_EMPTY_KMH
            truck.fuel_rate_lph = FUEL_RATE_DOWNHILL_EMPTY
            dist_step = (truck.speed_kmh / 3600.0) * dt
            truck.route_position_km += dist_step
            truck.progress_pct = min(100.0, (truck.route_position_km / truck.total_route_km) * 100.0)

            # Cool down tyres
            truck.tire_tkph = max(200.0, truck.tire_tkph - 0.08 * dt)

            if truck.route_position_km >= truck.total_route_km:
                truck.state = "queued_at_excavator"
                truck.speed_kmh = 0.0
                truck.progress_pct = 0.0
                truck.route_position_km = 0.0

        # Burn fuel
        fuel_burned = (truck.fuel_rate_lph / 3600.0) * dt
        truck.fuel_tank_l = max(50.0, truck.fuel_tank_l - fuel_burned)
        self.fuel_consumed_total_l += fuel_burned

modules.name: Модуль 1: Динамическая диспетчеризация (Dispatch)
modules.evidence: Контейнер openegiz-aktogay-simulator-1 работает, 5 двойников truck-01..05 меняют state/route_position/route_progress_pct в Ditto (truck-01 route_position 1.09→1.79 км за 35 с), у экскаваторов есть queue_length. Перенаправление при аварии EX-01 видно (truck-02 current_segment=diverted_to_ex2). Но в штатном режиме за ~28 мин симуляции все рудные рейсы ушли на EX-02: у excavator-01 tonnes_loaded=0, passes_total=0, потому что feed_grade держится на 0.52 > цели 0.48. Панели «Fleet Cycles & Queues» в дашборде openegiz-aktogay-mine нет: там 8 панелей (Cu, добыча, производительность, дизель, скорости, радар, расход топлива).

modules.name: Модуль 2: Управление качеством и шихтовка (Blending)
modules.evidence: crusher-01.feed_grade в Ditto меняется (0.48→0.40→0.52). Панель «Динамика содержания Cu на дробилке» читает value_feed_grade_properties_value из InfluxDB, за 10 мин набралось 73 точки. Но 25 мин симуляции подряд feed_grade стоял на 0.52, на верхней границе 0.48±0.04, и балансировка смесью двух забоев не наблюдалась: EX-01 не загружал ни разу.

modules.name: Модуль 3: Энергоэффективность и топливо (Energy & Fuel)
modules.evidence: truck-*.fuel_rate зависит от режима: 175 л/ч на подъёме с грузом, 20 при погрузке. fuel_level снижается (truck-01: 91.7→91.4 %), у mine-01 растут fuel_consumed_total (43.8→297.9 л) и energy_intensity (0.33 л/т). Панели «Расход топлива по машинам» и «Расход дизеля парка» читают InfluxDB, за 10 мин 438 точек fuel_rate. Удельный расход считается в л/т, а не в л/т·км, как заявлено.

modules.name: 3D-сцена Three.js (http://localhost:5000)
modules.evidence: GET / отдаёт HTML «Aktogay Open-Pit Copper Mine — 3D…», GET /api/state отдаёт JSON состояния. Данные сцена берёт из памяти симулятора (/api/state, team/web/app.js:1082), а не из Ditto или InfluxDB.

scenarios.name: Сценарий 1: Авария экскаватора богатой руды EX-01
scenarios.evidence: POST /api/whatif/ex1-fail → active=true. Через 60 с excavator-01.state: idle→breakdown, truck-02.current_segment: ramp_down→diverted_to_ex2, excavator-02: loading, queue_length=1. Заявленный забор руды со склада не наблюдался: stockpile-01 остался 45200 т / 0.51. После POST /api/whatif/reset: excavator-01.state=idle, у /api/state все флаги whatif=false.

scenarios.name: Сценарий 2: Оползневое перекрытие рампы +240м
scenarios.evidence: POST /api/whatif/road-block. slope-radar-01: status normal→alert_collapse, road_status open→closed_collapse, displacement 0.2→14.8 мм/сут. truck-01/03/05: current_segment→detour_bypass, длина маршрута truck-01 выросла примерно с 4.2 до 5.6 км (1.74 км = 31.1 %). После POST /api/whatif/reset: normal/open/0.2, сегменты ramp_down/ramp_main, длина маршрута снова около 4.2 км (2.8 км = 66.6 %).

scenarios.name: Сценарий 3: Резкое разубоживание в забое EX-02
scenarios.evidence: POST /api/whatif/dilution: excavator-02.face_grade 0.412→0.22. Заявленной компенсации не видно: за 90 с excavator-01 так и остался с tonnes_loaded=0 (рейсы к EX-01 не выросли), crusher-01.feed_grade неизменно 0.52. После POST /api/whatif/reset: face_grade EX-02 = 0.409, флаг dilution=false.

concept.evidence: Замысел о реальном медном карьере «Актогай» (KAZ Minerals): двойником пользуются диспетчер ГТК и начальник смены фабрики, решение — диспетчеризация самосвалов и шихтовка руды на 0.48% Cu.

built_on_openegiz.evidence: 1) В Ditto 13 вещей org.openegiz.aktogay:* (mine-01, excavator-01..03, truck-01..05, crusher-01, waste-dump-01, stockpile-01, slope-radar-01). 2) Соединения mosquitto-source-connection и mosquitto-target-connection в статусе open. Симулятор публикует Ditto-команды modify в MQTT telemetry/<name> (team/simulator.py), признаки меняются между снимками с разницей 35 с (truck-01 route_position 1.09→1.79, mine-01 tonnes_mined 0→227). 3) Все 8 панелей дашборда «Цифровой рудник «Актогай» (Team AURA)» (uid openegiz-aktogay-mine) используют datasource opentwins-influxdb, запросы через Grafana вернули данные (feed_grade 73 точки, speed 365). Оговорка: 3D-сцена на :5000 читает состояние из памяти симулятора (/api/state), а не из Ditto или InfluxDB.
